b'# tinydl

A small command-line downloader. It fetches a URL and writes the bytes to a
file or to stdout. See [Planning notes](notes.md) for background.

## Usage

Run the CLI with `python -m app.cli`. Every option below is produced by the
argument parser in `app/cli.py`; pass `--help` for the formatted version.

## Command line options

| Option | Argument | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | (positional) | what to download |
| `-o`, `--output` | | file to write (default: stdout) |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | | no progress output |
'
